title: [Bug] [Combov2] [Latest dev] Preferences tab craches on Android 12
symptom: The preferences tab crashes on Android 12 (Samsung Galaxy Flip 4) and the user cannot pair a combo. Other preference screens on other tabs work fine. The problem also occurs on Android 10 and Android 13, but not on Android 11 with the same build.
cause: The crash is caused by a ClassCastException where a String cannot be cast to Integer in SharedPreferences, likely due to a wrong value type stored in preferences. The issue appears when settings are imported, as a clean installation without imported data does not crash.
fix: The fix is to ignore wrong values in preferences, implemented in commit 57c96770b06aceb6d7868a923bc7e30d6032d88f. Users can also work around by doing a clean installation without importing settings.
evidence_quote: fixed by https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/57c96770b06aceb6d7868a923bc7e30d6032d88f (only ignore wrong value in preferences)
